fun_facts: Sheepshead don't just have human-like front teeth: a second set of flat molar plates further back in the throat grinds the shell they've already bitten through, essentially a built-in nutcracker most anglers never see.
A tagged sheepshead is often recaptured within casting distance of where it was first caught: adults tend to stay loyal to one piling, wreck, or jetty for years rather than roam.

Sheepshead are notorious bait thieves. Their bite is so light and precise that experienced anglers set the hook on a hunch, not a feel, because by the time the rod tip dips the bait may already be gone.
